name: title: roll srate +5
calls:
# diff
# Betaflight / SITL (SITL) 4.5.1
#
# THE DEFAULT BETAFLIGHT TUNE ON THE INTERCEPTOR.
#
# configs/betaflight-default.diff, line for line, with the airframe keys
# set to this build (docs/COMBAT-DRONES.md): 1300 kV motors and a 1800 mAh
# 6S LiPo, whose cell limits are the five inch's, 3.50 V. Every PID and
# filter value is Betaflight 4.5.1's factory default, as on the five inch.
#
# NO RATES, as in every tune here: rates are the pilot's (configs/rates.js).
#
# The airframe keys are STORED, not read: the plant's mass, kV, cells and
# rotors are constants in src/native/plant.c.
#
# Measured on its plant (scripts/combat-gates.js): a half stick roll step
# barely overshoots and reaches 63 percent of its rate in 15 ms, against
# the five inch's 20, on twice the five inch's roll authority.

batch start

board_name SITL

# ---- master ----

set motor_kv = 1300
set motor_poles = 14
set vbat_max_cell_voltage = 420
set vbat_min_cell_voltage = 350
set vbat_warning_cell_voltage = 350
set battery_capacity = 1800
set small_angle = 180

# Filters, 4.5 defaults
set gyro_hardware_lpf = NORMAL
set gyro_lpf1_type = PT1
set gyro_lpf1_static_hz = 250
set gyro_lpf2_type = PT1
set gyro_lpf2_static_hz = 500
set gyro_notch1_hz = 0
set gyro_notch1_cutoff = 0
set gyro_notch2_hz = 0
set gyro_notch2_cutoff = 0
set gyro_lpf1_dyn_min_hz = 250
set gyro_lpf1_dyn_max_hz = 500
set gyro_lpf1_dyn_expo = 5
set simplified_gyro_filter = ON
set simplified_gyro_filter_multiplier = 100

set dyn_notch_count = 3
set dyn_notch_q = 300
set dyn_notch_min_hz = 100
set dyn_notch_max_hz = 600

set yaw_spin_recovery = AUTO
set dshot_idle_value = 550
set mixer_type = LEGACY
set yaw_motors_reversed = OFF

# ---- profile 0 ----
profile 0

set pid_at_min_throttle = ON
set anti_gravity_gain = 80
set anti_gravity_cutoff_hz = 5
set anti_gravity_p_gain = 100
set acc_limit_yaw = 0
set acc_limit = 0

set iterm_rotation = OFF
set iterm_relax = RP
set iterm_relax_type = SETPOINT
set iterm_relax_cutoff = 15
set iterm_windup = 85
set iterm_limit = 400
set pidsum_limit = 500

# 400 is 40 percent of the mixer's yaw range, and it is why this tune's yaw
# feels loose next to its own roll and pitch. Betaflight's anti windup is
# driven only by getMotorMixRange against iterm_windup, so a yaw axis clipped
# at 40 percent can never on its own reach the 85 percent windup point: the
# I term keeps integrating for the whole time the axis is saturated. Measured
# here on a full stick yaw step, yaw I pins at its 400 cap for 225 ms, the
# rate overshoots 10.1 percent and the nose bounces back 75 deg/s. Raise the
# limit past about 480 and the discontinuity disappears (overshoot 8.4
# percent, bounce 60, I never caps), which is exactly the report in
# betaflight/betaflight issue 13486, open since March 2024 and unfixed.
#
# NOT CHANGED HERE ON PURPOSE. This file's whole job is to be what a freshly
# flashed quad flies, including the parts of that which are wrong. Round 23
# in PROGRESS.md has the sweep. Raising it to 1000 on the bench lands on the
# good side of it, which is what the preset that used to ship beside this one
# did.
set pidsum_limit_yaw = 400

set throttle_boost = 5
set throttle_boost_cutoff = 15

set p_roll = 45
set i_roll = 80
set d_roll = 40
set f_roll = 120
set p_pitch = 47
set i_pitch = 84
set d_pitch = 46
set f_pitch = 125
set p_yaw = 45
set i_yaw = 80
set d_yaw = 0
set f_yaw = 120

set d_min_roll = 30
set d_min_pitch = 34
set d_min_yaw = 0
set d_max_gain = 37
set d_max_advance = 20

set abs_control_gain = 0
set use_integrated_yaw = OFF

set thrust_linear = 0
set transient_throttle_limit = 0
set feedforward_transition = 0
set feedforward_max_rate_limit = 90

set dyn_idle_min_rpm = 0

set simplified_pids_mode = RPY
set simplified_master_multiplier = 100
set simplified_i_gain = 100
set simplified_d_gain = 100
set simplified_pi_gain = 100
set simplified_dmax_gain = 100
set simplified_feedforward_gain = 100
set simplified_pitch_d_gain = 100
set simplified_pitch_pi_gain = 100

set tpa_mode = D
set tpa_rate = 65
set tpa_breakpoint = 1350
set tpa_low_rate = 20
set tpa_low_breakpoint = 1050
set tpa_low_always = OFF

set dterm_lpf1_dyn_min_hz = 75
set dterm_lpf1_dyn_max_hz = 150
set dterm_lpf1_dyn_expo = 5
set dterm_lpf1_type = PT1
set dterm_lpf1_static_hz = 75
set dterm_lpf2_type = PT1
set dterm_lpf2_static_hz = 150
set dterm_notch_hz = 0
set dterm_notch_cutoff = 0
set yaw_lowpass_hz = 100
set simplified_dterm_filter = ON
set simplified_dterm_filter_multiplier = 100

batch end

# Rates, from the menu. See configs/rates.js.
rateprofile 0
set rates_type = ACTUAL
set roll_rc_rate = 7
set pitch_rc_rate = 7
set yaw_rc_rate = 7
set roll_srate = 72
set pitch_srate = 67
set yaw_srate = 67
set roll_expo = 0
set pitch_expo = 0
set yaw_expo = 0
set quickrates_rc_expo = OFF
set throttle_limit_type = OFF
set throttle_limit_percent = 100
set thr_mid = 50
set thr_expo = 0

calls:
# diff
# Betaflight / SITL (SITL) 4.5.1
#
# THE DEFAULT BETAFLIGHT TUNE ON THE INTERCEPTOR.
#
# configs/betaflight-default.diff, line for line, with the airframe keys
# set to this build (docs/COMBAT-DRONES.md): 1300 kV motors and a 1800 mAh
# 6S LiPo, whose cell limits are the five inch's, 3.50 V. Every PID and
# filter value is Betaflight 4.5.1's factory default, as on the five inch.
#
# NO RATES, as in every tune here: rates are the pilot's (configs/rates.js).
#
# The airframe keys are STORED, not read: the plant's mass, kV, cells and
# rotors are constants in src/native/plant.c.
#
# Measured on its plant (scripts/combat-gates.js): a half stick roll step
# barely overshoots and reaches 63 percent of its rate in 15 ms, against
# the five inch's 20, on twice the five inch's roll authority.

batch start

board_name SITL

# ---- master ----

set motor_kv = 1300
set motor_poles = 14
set vbat_max_cell_voltage = 420
set vbat_min_cell_voltage = 350
set vbat_warning_cell_voltage = 350
set battery_capacity = 1800
set small_angle = 180

# Filters, 4.5 defaults
set gyro_hardware_lpf = NORMAL
set gyro_lpf1_type = PT1
set gyro_lpf1_static_hz = 250
set gyro_lpf2_type = PT1
set gyro_lpf2_static_hz = 500
set gyro_notch1_hz = 0
set gyro_notch1_cutoff = 0
set gyro_notch2_hz = 0
set gyro_notch2_cutoff = 0
set gyro_lpf1_dyn_min_hz = 250
set gyro_lpf1_dyn_max_hz = 500
set gyro_lpf1_dyn_expo = 5
set simplified_gyro_filter = ON
set simplified_gyro_filter_multiplier = 100

set dyn_notch_count = 3
set dyn_notch_q = 300
set dyn_notch_min_hz = 100
set dyn_notch_max_hz = 600

set yaw_spin_recovery = AUTO
set dshot_idle_value = 550
set mixer_type = LEGACY
set yaw_motors_reversed = OFF

# ---- profile 0 ----
profile 0

set pid_at_min_throttle = ON
set anti_gravity_gain = 80
set anti_gravity_cutoff_hz = 5
set anti_gravity_p_gain = 100
set acc_limit_yaw = 0
set acc_limit = 0

set iterm_rotation = OFF
set iterm_relax = RP
set iterm_relax_type = SETPOINT
set iterm_relax_cutoff = 15
set iterm_windup = 85
set iterm_limit = 400
set pidsum_limit = 500

# 400 is 40 percent of the mixer's yaw range, and it is why this tune's yaw
# feels loose next to its own roll and pitch. Betaflight's anti windup is
# driven only by getMotorMixRange against iterm_windup, so a yaw axis clipped
# at 40 percent can never on its own reach the 85 percent windup point: the
# I term keeps integrating for the whole time the axis is saturated. Measured
# here on a full stick yaw step, yaw I pins at its 400 cap for 225 ms, the
# rate overshoots 10.1 percent and the nose bounces back 75 deg/s. Raise the
# limit past about 480 and the discontinuity disappears (overshoot 8.4
# percent, bounce 60, I never caps), which is exactly the report in
# betaflight/betaflight issue 13486, open since March 2024 and unfixed.
#
# NOT CHANGED HERE ON PURPOSE. This file's whole job is to be what a freshly
# flashed quad flies, including the parts of that which are wrong. Round 23
# in PROGRESS.md has the sweep. Raising it to 1000 on the bench lands on the
# good side of it, which is what the preset that used to ship beside this one
# did.
set pidsum_limit_yaw = 400

set throttle_boost = 5
set throttle_boost_cutoff = 15

set p_roll = 45
set i_roll = 80
set d_roll = 40
set f_roll = 120
set p_pitch = 47
set i_pitch = 84
set d_pitch = 46
set f_pitch = 125
set p_yaw = 45
set i_yaw = 80
set d_yaw = 0
set f_yaw = 120

set d_min_roll = 30
set d_min_pitch = 34
set d_min_yaw = 0
set d_max_gain = 37
set d_max_advance = 20

set abs_control_gain = 0
set use_integrated_yaw = OFF

set thrust_linear = 0
set transient_throttle_limit = 0
set feedforward_transition = 0
set feedforward_max_rate_limit = 90

set dyn_idle_min_rpm = 0

set simplified_pids_mode = RPY
set simplified_master_multiplier = 100
set simplified_i_gain = 100
set simplified_d_gain = 100
set simplified_pi_gain = 100
set simplified_dmax_gain = 100
set simplified_feedforward_gain = 100
set simplified_pitch_d_gain = 100
set simplified_pitch_pi_gain = 100

set tpa_mode = D
set tpa_rate = 65
set tpa_breakpoint = 1350
set tpa_low_rate = 20
set tpa_low_breakpoint = 1050
set tpa_low_always = OFF

set dterm_lpf1_dyn_min_hz = 75
set dterm_lpf1_dyn_max_hz = 150
set dterm_lpf1_dyn_expo = 5
set dterm_lpf1_type = PT1
set dterm_lpf1_static_hz = 75
set dterm_lpf2_type = PT1
set dterm_lpf2_static_hz = 150
set dterm_notch_hz = 0
set dterm_notch_cutoff = 0
set yaw_lowpass_hz = 100
set simplified_dterm_filter = ON
set simplified_dterm_filter_multiplier = 100

batch end

# Rates, from the menu. See configs/rates.js.
rateprofile 0
set rates_type = ACTUAL
set roll_rc_rate = 7
set pitch_rc_rate = 7
set yaw_rc_rate = 7
set roll_srate = 72
set pitch_srate = 67
set yaw_srate = 67
set roll_expo = 0
set pitch_expo = 0
set yaw_expo = 0
set quickrates_rc_expo = OFF
set throttle_limit_type = OFF
set throttle_limit_percent = 100
set thr_mid = 50
set thr_expo = 0
